plainTranslation: Total intensity. The Pluto person reshapes the Sun person's sense of self. Magnetic, transformative, prone to power struggles. Watch control dressed as care. Hard aspects crank the friction; trine and sextile let the depth flow without the war. Intensity isn't compatibility - choose with your eyes open.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
